function.name: game_functions_solve_jigsaw
function.description: Generate solution for a given jigsaw puzzle image. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

puzzle_image.description: The image file of the jigsaw puzzle.

pieces_count.description: Number of pieces in the jigsaw puzzle.

solve_method.description: Method to be used to solve the puzzle. Default is brute_force.

message.content: I can help you solve a jigsaw puzzle if you provide me with an image and let me know how many pieces it has. Unfortunately, I don’t have a built‑in tool for generating new puzzles from scratch. If you’d like to give me an image (or describe what you’d like the puzzle to look like) and the desired number of pieces, I can use the `game_functions_solve_jigsaw` tool to assemble it for you.
